Even if you select two Availability Zones when conﬁguring your domain, OpenSearch Service
automatically distributes dedicated master nodes across three Availability Zones. This distribution
helps prevent cluster downtime if a zone experiences a service disruption. If you use the
recommended three dedicated master nodes and one Availability Zone goes down, your cluster still
has a quorum (2) of dedicated master nodes and can elect a new master. The following diagram
demonstrates this conﬁguration.
If you choose an older-generation instance type that is not available in three Availability Zones, the
following scenarios apply:
• If you chose three Availability Zones for the domain, OpenSearch Service throws an error. Choose
a diﬀerent instance type, and try again.
• If you chose two Availability Zones for the domain, OpenSearch Service distributes the dedicated
master nodes across two zones.
